 Here are the predictions for the ICC Women's Emerging Nations Trophy 2026 Super Sixes on November 20, featuring Scotland vs Netherlands, Sri Lanka vs Zimbabwe and Pakistan vs Ireland in Ajman.
 Match Prediction - Scotland Women v Netherlands Women 
 LIVE SCORES - Match 21 (Super Sixes Match 1) - Scotland Women vs Netherlands Women (Karwan Cricket Ground, Ajman) 
 Current Form Scotland Women: 
 Scotland Women finished at the 2nd position on Group A points table and they have qualified for the Super Sixes. They will face Netherlands Women in the 1st Super Six Match.
 The top run scorer for Scotland Women in the ICC Women's Emerging Nations Trophy 2026 is Darcey Carter with 100 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Scotland Women in the ICC Women's Emerging Nations Trophy 2026 is Kirstie Gordon with 8 scalps under her belt.
 Scotland Women have won their previous match against Ireland Women by 8 wickets.
 Ireland Women batted first and they posted a total of 71 before being bowled out. They got off to the most terrible start and were reduced to 38 for 6 in the 11th over itself. Kirstie Gordon showcased her skills with the ball in T20 format. She picked up 4 wickets for just 4 runs in her spell of 4 overs. Abtaha Maqsood also contributed well with the ball. She picked up 3 wickets for 15 runs as Scotland Women were eventually bowled out for a small total of 71.
 During the chase, Darcey Carter and Katherine Fraser looked determined to chase the target down in a hurry. Carter made 30 while Fraser scored 21 runs in only 13 balls. On the back of their determination and brilliance with the bat, Scotland Women were able to chase the target down in the 9th over itself with 8 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Netherlands Women: 
 Netherlands Women finished at the 2nd position on Group B points table and they have qualified for the Super Sixes. They will face Scotland Women in the 1st Super Six Match.
 The top run scorer for Netherlands Women in the ICC Women's Emerging Nations Trophy 2026 is Sterre Kalis with 139 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Netherlands Women in the ICC Women's Emerging Nations Trophy 2026 is Heather Siegers with 7 scalps under her belt.
 Netherlands Women have lost their previous match against Zimbabwe Women by a big margin of 33 runs.
 Zimbabwe Women batted first and they posted a big total of 160 for 2 in 20 overs. Kelis Ndhlovu made 74 runs in 45 balls, collecting 6 fours and 6 sixes. Modester Mupachikwa also showcased her experience and class. She scored 33 runs in 36 balls. Beloved Biza and Nyasha Gwanzura also contributed healthily as Zimbabwe Women managed to get to a tall total of 160 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Netherlands Women couldn't get off to an ideal start. Babette de Leede and Sterre Kalis got out cheaply. Wickets kept falling in regular succession as Christine Mutasa picked up 3 wickets for just 19 runs. Nomvelo Sibanda also contributed well with the ball. She accounted for 2 scalps and Netherlands Women looked in all sorts of bother. Robine Rijke fought hard but the target was way too tall to dream of winning. Netherlands Women were eventually restricted to 127 for 7 in 20 overs, losing the match by 33 runs.
